canonical_brand.name: SongChart
canonical_brand.rule: New source, configuration, UI copy and generated documentation use SongChart. Legacy names may remain only in immutable history until that history is compacted or archived.

principles: Prefer Laravel first-party capabilities before third-party packages.
Prefer mature documented packages before SongChart-specific infrastructure abstractions.
Keep custom code only where SongChart domain semantics or security boundaries are genuinely product-specific.
Every package adoption must name the custom surface it replaces or prevents.
Retire replaced code in the same or immediately following bounded tranche; do not keep permanent dual implementations.
Behavioral invariants belong in tests; declarative invariants belong in repository contracts rather than new one-off verifier scripts.
Optimization is a continuous delivery concern, not an occasional audit.

Technology freshness is continuously evaluated, but newness alone is never an adoption reason; compatibility, SWOT, ROI, retirement payoff and operating cost decide whether a technology is adopted now, evaluated in a bounded tranche, watched, or rejected.

continuous_optimization_cycle.decision_rule: Implement low-risk optimization in the current tranche when it is owned by the same semantic surface; otherwise register a bounded retirement/automation item here with a target phase. Do not defer by forgetting it in chat.
continuous_optimization_cycle.closure_rule: A tranche is incomplete if it introduces a package or replacement abstraction without recording what old surface is removed, retained temporarily, or explicitly deferred.
continuous_optimization_cycle.source_budget_rule: Prefer net source reduction when replacing custom infrastructure. Added framework/package glue should be smaller and more documented than the retired custom surface.
continuous_optimization_cycle.documentation_rule: Stable knowledge is captured in machine-readable repository authorities so API/developer/FAQ projections can be generated instead of independently maintained.

technology_watch.purpose: Keep SongChart current without creating upgrade churn or novelty-driven architecture. Every relevant framework, package, runtime, AI/MCP, test, security, deployment or operations candidate is evaluated against the current accepted baseline and the semantic owner being changed.
evidence_priority: official release notes, compatibility documentation and security advisories
official package/framework documentation and maintained source repository
existing SongChart runtime and verification evidence
mature community evidence only when official evidence is insufficient

adoption_decisions.adopt_now: Use when compatibility is proven, ROI is clearly positive, the semantic owner is in the current tranche, and the replacement retires or prevents more custom/operational surface than it adds.
adoption_decisions.bounded_evaluation: Use when expected ROI is positive but compatibility, migration effort or semantic ownership requires a focused proof before adoption.
adoption_decisions.watch: Use when upstream direction is promising but maturity, compatibility, product need or retirement payoff is not yet sufficient.
adoption_decisions.reject: Use when added complexity, ownership overlap, lock-in or migration/maintenance cost is greater than the measurable benefit for SongChart.

technology_watch.anti_novelty_rule: Do not upgrade or add a technology only because a newer release, package or architecture exists. Prefer the newest proven option that materially improves SongChart under the ROI and ownership rules.
technology_watch.replacement_rule: Every adopt-now decision records what native/custom/package surface is replaced, what remains SongChart-specific, what files or operational responsibilities can retire, and the target tranche for any temporary remainder.
technology_watch.freshness_rule: Re-evaluate relevant candidates when their semantic surface is touched, before package admission or major runtime changes, and when upstream compatibility/security evidence materially changes. Do not rely on a periodic chat-memory audit.
technology_watch.recording_rule: Stable SWOT/ROI decisions and deferred technology opportunities belong in repository machine authority or the owning bounded tranche; chat memory is not an authority.

free_tier_delivery.constraint: Private repository branch protection/ruleset enforcement is unavailable on the current GitHub Free plan.
free_tier_delivery.strategy: Use PR Auto Closure as the normal promotion path and add post-push provenance detection that blocks release acceptance when main receives an ungoverned change.
free_tier_delivery.do_not_build: Do not create a complex custom branch-protection clone. Detection, evidence and release blocking are sufficient until the hosting plan changes.

ai_framework_context.target: provide framework/package documentation search and Laravel runtime/schema/route context to AI while repository project-context and project-knowledge remain SongChart-specific memory authority

browser_testing.target: run documented Playwright-backed browser and mobile critical smoke tests in CI with screenshot/trace evidence for remote diagnosis

external_api_clients.target: standardize provider connectors, requests, auth, retries, fixtures and HTTP test recording while preserving SongChart provider taxonomy and canonical identity semantics

cross_boundary_data.target: consolidate DTO, request validation, API resource transformation and future TypeScript contract generation

authorization.target: retain native Gates while roles and permissions remain static; evaluate spatie/laravel-permission only if runtime-managed roles or permissions become a product requirement

queue_runtime.target: replace custom worker supervision and queue operational dashboards while preserving SongChart job taxonomy, retries and admission semantics

application_observability.target: use Pulse for request, job, query, cache and runtime visibility; custom cards only for SongChart-specific provider health semantics

health_checks.target: use native health endpoints where sufficient; evaluate spatie/laravel-health only when aggregated readiness checks are required

backup.target: delegate backup orchestration, retention and notifications; keep SongChart-owned isolated restore drill as release evidence

activity_audit.target: use package persistence and query tooling behind explicit privileged use-case audit calls; avoid broad model-event audit

security_platform.target: use framework/platform authentication, authorization, CSRF, rate limiting, secure cookies, TLS and headers; custom security remains only for provider destination validation, outbound URL policy and other product-specific trust boundaries

retirement_queue.action: migrate declarative checks into repository contracts and behavioral checks into Pest/Architecture tests
retain as diagnostic fallback until auto-closure is proven across several tranches, then reduce or retire
replace in active source/config/UI/docs with SongChart; preserve immutable historical references only when needed for chronology

retirement_queue.target: native worker operational glue superseded by Horizon
retirement_queue.action: after Horizon acceptance remove duplicate supervision/dashboard assumptions while retaining only deployment entrypoints that Horizon actually requires
inventory and migrate eligible integrations to Saloon connectors/requests in bounded provider tranches
inventory and migrate eligible cross-boundary data objects to spatie/laravel-data before public API expansion

automation_backlog.action: detect ungoverned main pushes and block release acceptance without attempting to emulate paid branch protection
Pest Browser critical desktop/mobile smoke with screenshot/trace artifact on failure
emit machine owner/risk/gate/evidence summary from existing registries when CI fails
bounded Dependabot/Renovate PRs verified by Auto Closure
generate API/developer/FAQ documentation from project knowledge, route authority and typed data contracts
accepted-main package, tag and GitHub Release automation from exact accepted SHA
scheduled isolated backup restore drill with bounded redacted evidence
